question.questionText: Какие способы оптимизации веб-приложений вы знаете?
question.shortAnswer: Оптимизация на трёх уровнях: сеть (Gzip/Brotli, CDN, HTTP/2, Cache-Control), загрузка (code splitting, React.lazy, lazy images WebP/AVIF), runtime (debounce, Web Workers, virtualization, React.memo после профайлера). Сначала измеряй: Lighthouse, Web Vitals LCP/FID/CLS.
question.idealAnswer: Measure first: Lighthouse, Web Vitals (LCP<2.5s, FID<100ms, CLS<0.1), DevTools Performance, WebPageTest. Network: Gzip -60-80% text, Brotli -15-20% vs Gzip; CDN edge reduces RTT; HTTP/2 multiplex eliminates HOL blocking; Cache-Control max-age=31536000 immutable on hashed assets, HTML no-cache+ETag. Code splitting: dynamic import(), React.lazy+Suspense — 800KB→50-100KB chunks per route. Images: WebP/AVIF, loading=lazy below fold not hero LCP; width/height prevent CLS; picture element or CDN format negotiation. Debounce search 300ms (-80-90% API calls); throttle scroll. Web Workers postMessage for CSV/sort off main thread. react-window 10k rows → 15 DOM nodes. React.memo/useMemo/useCallback only after Profiler confirms re-render bottleneck — preemptive memo adds overhead. Mistakes: memo everything; too many tiny chunks; CDN without cache headers; lazy above-fold hero; optimize without profile.

checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: Cache-Control max-age immutable hashed assets; HTML no-cache+ETag; Last-Modified; CDN no-store wastes cache.

checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: dynamic import(); React.lazy+Suspense; route-level splitting; loading=lazy images; not over-split tiny chunks.

falseClaims: one bundle always faster than chunks
lazy loading hero image improves LCP

checkpoints.title: Оптимизирует изображения и статику
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: WebP/AVIF vs JPEG; picture element; width/height anti-CLS; Cloudinary/Imgix; lazy not above fold.

falseClaims: lazy on hero logo improves LCP

checkpoints.title: Оптимизирует runtime: debounce, workers, virtualization
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: debounce search; throttle scroll; Web Workers no DOM; react-window 10k→15 nodes; debounce vs throttle.

falseClaims: virtualization loads less data from server
debounce and throttle identical for scroll
10k DOM rows same perf as virtualized

checkpoints.title: Применяет React memoization обоснованно
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: React.memo/useMemo/useCallback after Profiler; shallow compare cost; cheap components skip memo.
